# gsm_project_file_collector_sink (Resource)

Manages a project file collector sink, the destination that the file collector sidecar uploads game server files to.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "gsm_project_file_collector_sink" "logs" {
  project_id               = "<project_id>"
  file_collector_sink_name = "logs-s3"

  s3 {
    bucket = "docs-game-logs"
    region = "ap-northeast-2"
    # The role must trust the GSM workload OIDC issuer for subject gsm:workload/filecollector:<project>:logs-s3
    aws_role_arn = "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/docs-file-collector"

    object_tags = {
      environment = "production"
    }

    # Omit to use the default layout <path_prefix>/dt=YYYY-MM-DD/hour=HH/<cluster>/<namespace>/<pod>/<file>
    key_template = "games/{{.Cluster}}/dt={{.StartedAt.Format \"2006-01-02\"}}/{{.Namespace}}/{{.Pod}}/{{.File}}"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `file_collector_sink_name` (String) Name of the file collector sink. Squadron templates reference the sink by this name.
- `project_id` (String) Project ID where the file collector sink belongs
- `s3` (Block List, Min: 1, Max: 1) S3 destination of collected files (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--s3))

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the file collector sink. Changing it recreates the sink because the update API does not accept a description.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedblock--s3"></a>
### Nested Schema for `s3`

Required:

- `aws_role_arn` (String) IAM role assumed by the file collector. The role must trust the GSM workload OIDC issuer for subject `gsm:workload/filecollector:<project>:<sink name>`.
- `bucket` (String) S3 bucket name
- `region` (String) AWS region of the bucket

Optional:

- `key_template` (String) Go template that renders the S3 object key of each uploaded file. Empty uses the default layout `<path_prefix>/dt=YYYY-MM-DD/hour=HH/<cluster>/<namespace>/<pod>/<file>`. Available values: `.Cluster`, `.StartedAt`, `.TargetPrefix`, `.Namespace`, `.Pod`, `.File`. It must reference `.Namespace`, `.Pod` and `.File` so that objects are not overwritten. The GSM API validates the template.
- `object_tags` (Map of String) Tags attached to every uploaded object


<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `default` (String)
